Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 의뢰를 성공한 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 잔소리 좀 그만하라며 우는 소리를 했다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: After a successful quest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> whined and demanded I stop nagging her.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 依頼を成功させた<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は小言はやめてくれと泣き言を言った。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 成功完成委托的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>抱怨说要我别再唠叨了。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 成功完成委託的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>抱怨說要我別再嘮叨了。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Après avoir réussi la quête, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> s'est plainte en pleurant que je devais arrêter de lui faire des reproches.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss der Quest jammerte <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, ich solle mit dem Nörgeln aufhören.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Tras completar la misión, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lloriqueó y me pidió que dejara de regañarla.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Depois de completar a missão, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> choramingou e pediu para eu parar de incomodá-la.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ที่ทำภารกิจสำเร็จแล้วก็บ่นงอแงว่าให้หยุดบ่นได้แล้ว
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Setelah berhasil menyelesaikan misi, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> merengek dan memintaku untuk berhenti mengomelinya.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Sau khi hoàn thành nhiệm vụ, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã rên rỉ và yêu cầu tôi ngừng cằn nhằn cô ấy.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने सफलतापूर्वक अनुरोध पूरा करने के बाद, 'डांटना बंद करो' कहते हुए रोना-धोना किया।
